Definition: to link, i.e. gird; figuratively, to serve, (mentally) contrive
BiblicalUsage: tsâmad means to link, i.e. gird. It appears 5 times in Scripture, including Numbers 25:3 and Psalms 106:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâmad shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
